testcase.name: each response reports the coordinates it was actually given()
in December the separation is small and reversed()
every tithi-bounded parana agrees and every sunrise-bounded one does not()
at the equinox the separation is about a quarter of an hour()
a parana bounded by the end of Hari Vasara is identical in both cities()
mid-June is the widest separation, and it is over half an hour()
